items.raw_excerpt: Northern Ireland has become the first country in the world to eradicate an invasive ferret population from an inhabited island.

items.raw_excerpt: State-owned oil supplier CPC Corp., Taiwan, announced Saturday it will raise domestic gasoline and diesel prices by NT$0.7 (US$0.02) and NT$0.5 per liter next week, respectively, in response to a spike in international crude oil prices amid escalating tensions in the Middle East.
items.summary_en: CPC Corp. Taiwan will raise gasoline prices by NT$0.7 per liter and diesel prices by NT$0.5 per liter next week. The price hike comes in response to rising international crude oil prices driven by tensions in the Middle East. The increase equals roughly US$0.02 per liter for gasoline.
